caption: The drawing depicts a wooden mallet with a cylindrical head and a long handle. The mallet head is made of a weathered, grayish-blue wood and is reinforced at both ends with rusty, reddish-brown metal bands. The handle is attached perpendicularly through the mallet head, and it displays a natural wood grain with brown and dark streaks. Both the handle and the mallet head appear aged, showing wear and grain texture distinctly. The background is a plain, light beige with no additional objects or details. In the lower left corner, the text "Orison Daeda 1939" is written in small, neat letters.
title: Hawsing Beetle
